حققن (form I)
# حَقَقْنَ (ḥaqaqna) /ħa.qaq.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# حُقِقْنَ (ḥuqiqna) /ħu.qiq.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa) and حُقَّ (ḥuqqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
